column1: Ztracené reference vazeb: {0}. Plocha, na kterou vazba ukazovala, po úpravě dílu neexistuje nebo není jednoznačná – vazba je mimo řešení a komponenty se kvůli ní nehýbou. Vyberte plochu znovu, nebo vazbu smažte.
column2: Lost mate references: {0}. The face the mate pointed to no longer exists after the part change or is ambiguous – the mate is out of the solve and components do not move because of it. Pick the face again, or delete the mate.

column1: nová plocha strany vazby – oprava ztracené reference: po úpravě dílu v kontextu (sestava hotovo, Zpět do sestavy) se plochy vazeb ověří podle geometrie; plocha, která zmizela nebo jde na víc míst, je ✗ mate.lost a vazba je mimo řešení (komponenta stojí); plocha = F-číslo nebo pravidlo jako u nové vazby, bez strany = ztracená strana
column2: new face for one side of a mate – repair of a lost reference: after editing a part in context (assembly done, Back to assembly) the mate faces are checked by geometry; a face that disappeared or matches several places is ✗ mate.lost and the mate is out of the solve (the component stays); face = F number or a rule as for a new mate, without a side = the lost side
